data.synopsis:
The film features three distinct segments, each with its own unique setting and premise, blending together into a single cohesive anthology. The first segment, titled Æliens, follows an alien girl who teams up with a space agency civil servant on a frantic search for friends.

Following that is Yoroshiku★Shoujo, a chaotic battle royale narrative that centers on a group of girls competing in a fierce game known as "Queen of Butterfly."

The final story, Nocturn: En Cette Nuit Grotesque, chronicles the journey of a pureblood vampire and three girls who managed to survive by becoming infected after she fed on them.

data.synopsis:
Noriko Tachiki has dreamt of a beautiful fantasy land for some time, though her friends think it is only her imagination. One day, on her way home, Noriko stumbles upon a bomb disguised as a paper bag that explodes right in front of her. However, instead of dying, she is transported to a mysterious forest full of strange plants and creatures.

As she begins navigating through the woods, Noriko is suddenly attacked by a giant, worm-like monster. Fortunately, she is saved by Izark Kia Tarj, a swordsman who does not speak her language. Lacking the strength to survive on her own, Noriko decides to follow her stoic savior, taking the opportunity to learn the foreign land's language and be more useful to Izark.

Unbeknownst to her, Noriko is a crucial piece of an ancient prophecy. She is "The Awakening"—a being destined to unleash the greatest evil known as the "Sky Demon." With influential people plotting to capture Noriko for her supposed powers, both she and Izark must fend for themselves and overcome a future laced with chaos.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

data.synopsis:
One day, high school student Yuuka "Yuu" Hirasaka finds herself transported to the world of Twisted Wonderland after a black carriage crashes into her. Though she hopes to return home to Tochigi in Japan, the magicless judo practitioner ends up enrolling in the prestigious magic academy Night Raven College.

As Yuu acclimates to her new life, the annual interdorm Spelldrive tournament at the school is set to begin. The team-based game tests the physical and magical strength of each dorm's seven best athletes, all while being broadcast throughout the magical world. For the past two years, the Diasomnia dorm has crushed the competition thanks solely to their powerful housewarden, Malleus Draconia.

Amidst the excitement, a series of incidents across campus befalling the top Spelldrive players from all dorms is rendering them unable to compete. Concerned that these are no mere accidents, the headmage of the academy tasks Yuu and her dormmate Grim to investigate. While the pair dives deeper into the matter, one housewarden in particular is determined to defeat Diasomnia—even if he must use underhanded methods to do so.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

data.synopsis:
In a world where many different species coexist, Satoru Takahashi inherits his father's youkai-exclusive apartment complex after he passes away. One day, Takahashi meets and instantly becomes attracted to a yuki-onna, or snow woman, named Yukino. Although they initially get along, an argument drives the two apart.

While pondering how to fix their situation, Takahashi finds a strange ring inside a mysterious box. The included description states that if one directs their desires at a youkai who is within view of the ring, it is possible to control their mind. Takahashi remains skeptical until, during another desperate attempt to talk to Yukino, he shows the ring to her and witnesses its potential. With immense power at his fingertips, Takahashi must decide whether to use the ring to restore his relationship with Yukino or to fulfill his primitive desires.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

data.synopsis:
Karasu Bank is one of Japan's leading banks, boasting the third-highest operating profits in the country. Akira Mitarai is a young employee in his second year at the bank's central branch. His exceptional math skills allow him to instantly spot accounting errors but also make his day-to-day life incredibly boring.

One day, Akira is suddenly transferred to the Special Operations Department's "Appraisal Unit," which he is told is a key department within the bank. Suspicious of his transfer and the unfamiliar department, he is told by his new boss that the bank actually operates a massive underground casino, and that the Appraisal Unit is the department responsible for managing this gambling as well as the gamblers who participate in it. But these gamblers are putting more than just their money on the line, with their very lives serving as collateral to play! Higher risk means higher rewards, but at the top level losing is a death sentence.

Overwhelmed and confused by the strange state of the bank's secret casino, Mitarai meets a mysterious, genius gambler, Shin Mafutsu. Enraptured by Shin's ability to see through his opponents' cheating and emerge victorious, Akira decides to enter the world of life-or-death gambling as Shin's bank representative.

(Source: MAL News)
